description: Pass --plan-approval operator to the hermetic init smoke in build-release.sh to suppress the false-positive Resend-not-configured warning on every build.

userStories.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding
userStories.notes: CRITICAL [scripts/build-release.sh:114]: The story's behavioral goal (AC4) is not achieved: after adding `--plan-approval operator` to the hermetic init smoke, an independent `bun run build:release` STILL emits `plan_approval is "auto" but Resend is not configured` and records `Plan approval: auto`. The `--plan-approval` flag is silently ignored by init: parseSetupArgs (src/commands/setup.ts:847-865) parses it into setupArgs.planApproval, but index.ts (init case lines 2510-2516, setup case lines 2531-2537) builds runSetup({...}) omitting planApproval, so options.planApproval is always undefined, the interactive prompt fires, reads EOF from </dev/null and defaults to auto. The one-line build-release.sh change is a no-op. Fix must forward planApproval into the runSetup calls in index.ts (the pre-existing wiring gap this story failed to diagnose).

userStories.title: Pass --plan-approval operator to the hermetic init smoke
userStories.description: As a cam-cli maintainer, I need the hermetic init smoke in build-release.sh to run with --plan-approval operator so that the false-positive 'plan_approval is auto but Resend is not configured' warning stops firing on every build, preserving the warning's signal without weakening the real product-side warning.
acceptanceCriteria: The hermetic init smoke invocation in scripts/build-release.sh (~line 114) passes `--plan-approval operator` in addition to its existing --no-tmux --existing --issue-system none --merge-mode immediate flags. [oracle: grep -q -- '--plan-approval operator' scripts/build-release.sh]

The init smoke command line still retains all its existing isolation flags (--no-tmux, --existing, --issue-system none, --merge-mode immediate, </dev/null). [oracle: file-assert grep -Eq 'init .*--no-tmux .*--existing .*--issue-system none .*--merge-mode immediate' scripts/build-release.sh]

No product-side change is made to warnIfResendUnconfigured: it still warns when plan_approval is auto and Resend is unconfigured, so a real non-interactive auto init without Resend still warns. [oracle: file-assert grep -q "planApproval === 'auto' && (resendApiKey === '' || resendRecipient === '')" src/commands/setup.ts]
`bun run build:release --install` emits no `plan_approval is "auto" but Resend is not configured` warning during the init smoke, exits 0, and installs the binary. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Single-file change: scripts/build-release.sh line ~114. Add `--plan-approval operator` to the `init` invocation, alongside the existing --no-tmux --existing --issue-system none --merge-mode immediate flags. The flag is parsed at src/commands/setup.ts:848 (accepts auto|operator). warnIfResendUnconfigured (src/commands/setup.ts:301) only fires when planApproval === 'auto', so the operator branch skips it. Do NOT touch src/commands/setup.ts (rejected option B: a real non-interactive auto init without Resend SHOULD still warn). The smoke tmpdir config is deleted on the EXIT trap, so recording operator instead of auto is inconsequential; the smoke asserts only on the init exit code, never on warning output, so no assertion breaks.
